oracle.method: Closed forms of the stated linear laws (see reference.py): the completion that adjusts for the confounder identifies the level 3 with the unit-contrast witness 2; the completion that does not identifies the association 3.441 (static law) or 3.209 (temporal law) with witness 2.299, by the omitted-variable-bias slope evaluated in exact rationals from the stated moments. The refuter contract lists the refuters each level study runs at each depth and inference mode (validation-suite design, not derivable); placebo and dummy outcome have the exact null 0, the random common cause, bootstrap and subset refuters the original value. The e-value, subset and prior-predictive verdicts depend on the sample, the interval and the prior scale and are not asserted; the posterior predictive verdict is.
oracle.formula: adjusted: 1 + 2 + b E z; unadjusted: E y + (2 + b cov(t,z)/var(t)) (1 - E t)
asserted_outputs: closed_form.* (completion levels and witnesses within tolerance.level)
refuter_contract (refuters that run, null and original expectations)
context_only_outputs: verdict_not_asserted (documents which verdicts are sample dependent)
oracle.independence_basis: The generator evaluates the stated moments and the omitted-variable-bias formula in exact rationals; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated laws.
oracle.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the stated law and the declared inputs; no product implementation source was consulted to obtain the values.

reference_review.scope: The interventional level of each completion of a class graph and the unit-contrast witness the temporal refuters run on, with the refuter contract of the level study.

reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: Law-level truth for simulated samples; sampling error is covered by the stated 0.15 band. Each completion is checked on its own level or witness; the refuter contract, tolerance bands and the unasserted verdicts are validation-suite design choices asserted by the executing tests. No coverage or calibration claim.
